notes: Src link is the maker FAQ for the Loft Go! 7D EQ (redirects to the US FAQ); it has no price or rider height. Trek site search for 'loft go' redirects to the Loft Go category, which is a 404, so it is no longer sold new, but no page says discontinued — status left empty. No maker USD price found; 99 Spokes (aggregator, kind 'review') gives 'Manufacturer Price $1,499'. Skiis & Biikes is a Canadian dealer (CAD prices; not used for price). EBR only has the older Bosch Loft Go! 8i (different bike, not used). REI listing exists but REI is bot-blocked. One WebSearch used. recheck (height, fold): maker product pages are gone (electra.trekbikes.com /p/36417 in US and ES both 404). Scheller's (US dealer) Loft Go! 7D EQ Step-Thru page: S and M sizes, 20 mph, 250Wh, non-folding 6061-T6 frame, but no rider heights. 99 Spokes Step-Over page lists LG 5'8"-6'4". No source found for the site's 5'0"-6'3"; combined 99 Spokes ranges are 5'6"-6'4". Used the bike's one WebSearch.
